/*selectMasterMpIfCretecPoList*/
SELECT A.AGENT , A.BUYER , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , A.PR_NO , A.PR_SEQ , A.PO_NO , A.PO_SEQ , NVL(A.REVISION, 0) AS REVISION , CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'S' THEN '0' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'N' THEN '1' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'F' THEN '2' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'D' THEN '6' END AS IF_FLAG , A.IF_MSG , A.AGENT_PO_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.SELLER_ITEM_NO , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.ITEM_QTY , A.AGENT_PRICE , A.AGENT_ITEM_AMT , A.WAREHOUSE_CODE , A.IF_FLAG AS IF_FLAG_RAW , TO_CHAR(A.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE , TO_CHAR(A.IF_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS IF_DATE , A.DATA09 , A.DATA10 , CASE WHEN NVL(A.REVISION, 0) = MAX(NVL(A.REVISION, 0)) OVER ( PARTITION BY A.BUYER, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LATEST_YN ,CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMPRDT P WHERE P.BUYER=A.BUYER AND P.PR_NO=A.PR_NO AND P.PR_SEQ=A.PR_SEQ AND P.STATUS<>'D' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ORDER_EXISTS_YN ,CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMIVDT D WHERE D.BUYER=A.BUYER AND D.PR_NO=A.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ=A.PR_SEQ AND D.STATUS<>'D' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELIVERY_EXISTS_YN FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.PR_NO = #{st_pr_no} AND A.PR_SEQ = #{st_pr_seq} ORDER BY NVL(A.REVISION, 0) DESC , A.CREATE_DATE DESC

/*selectMpIfCretecPoListPop*/
SELECT O.BUYER ,(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=O.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME ,O.PR_NO ,O.PR_SEQ ,O.REVISION ,O.IF_FLAG ,O.IF_MSG ,O.AGENT_PO_NO ,TO_CHAR(O.CREATE_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE ,TO_CHAR(O.IF_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS IF_DATE ,O.AGENT AS OLD_AGENT ,O.PO_NO AS OLD_PO_NO ,O.PO_SEQ AS OLD_PO_SEQ ,O.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS OLD_SELLER_ITEM_NO ,O.DESCRIPTION AS OLD_DESCRIPTION ,O.SPECIFICATION AS OLD_SPECIFICATION ,O.ITEM_QTY AS OLD_ITEM_QTY ,O.AGENT_PRICE AS OLD_AGENT_PRICE ,O.AGENT_ITEM_AMT AS OLD_AGENT_ITEM_AMT ,O.UNIT_MEASURE AS OLD_UNIT_MEASURE ,O.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS OLD_WAREHOUSE_CODE ,C.AGENT AS CURRENT_AGENT ,C.PO_NO AS CURRENT_PO_NO ,C.PO_SEQ AS CURRENT_PO_SEQ ,C.UNIT_MEASURE AS CURRENT_UNIT_MEASURE ,C.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS CURRENT_WAREHOUSE_CODE ,C.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS CURRENT_SELLER_ITEM_NO ,C.DESCRIPTION AS CURRENT_DESCRIPTION ,C.SPECIFICATION AS CURRENT_SPECIFICATION ,C.ITEM_QTY AS CURRENT_ITEM_QTY ,C.AGENT_PRICE AS CURRENT_AGENT_PRICE ,C.AGENT_ITEM_AMT AS CURRENT_AGENT_ITEM_AMT ,CASE WHEN O.REVISION=( SELECT MAX(X.REVISION) FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND X WHERE X.BUYER=O.BUYER AND X.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND X.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LATEST_YN ,CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMPRDT P WHERE P.BUYER=O.BUYER AND P.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND P.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ AND P.STATUS!='D' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ORDER_EXISTS_YN ,CASE WHEN O.IF_FLAG='N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS WAIT_YN ,CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMIVDT V WHERE V.BUYER=O.BUYER AND V.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND V.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ AND V.STATUS!='D' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELIVERY_EXISTS_YN ,CASE WHEN TRIM(C.SELLER_ITEM_NO) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SELLER_ITEM_EXISTS_YN FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND O LEFT OUTER JOIN( SELECT A.AGENT ,B.BUYER ,B.PR_NO ,B.PR_SEQ ,B.PO_NO ,B.PO_SEQ ,B.SELLER_ITEM_NO ,B.DESCRIPTION ,B.SPECIFICATION ,B.ITEM_QTY ,B.AGENT_PRICE ,B.AGENT_ITEM_AMT ,B.UNIT_MEASURE ,CASE WHEN B.PROCESS_TYPE='0' THEN '' ELSE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE END AS WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPOHD A ,ICOMPODT B ,ICOMPRDT P WHERE A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO=B.PO_NO AND A.STATUS!='D' AND A.AGENT IN('KRCRET0001','KRCRET0002') AND B.BUYER=P.BUYER AND B.PR_NO=P.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ=P.PR_SEQ AND B.STATUS!='D' AND P.STATUS!='D' AND B.ITEM_QTY>0 AND B.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND B.PR_NO=#{st_pr_no} AND B.PR_SEQ=#{st_pr_seq} ) C ON C.BUYER=O.BUYER AND C.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND C.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ WHERE O.AGENT=#{st_agent} AND O.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND O.PO_NO=#{st_po_no} AND O.PO_SEQ=#{st_po_seq} AND O.STATUS='C' AND O.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND O.PR_NO=#{st_pr_no} AND O.PR_SEQ=#{st_pr_seq}

SELECT O.IF_FLAG ,O.REVISION ,CASE WHEN O.REVISION=( SELECT MAX(X.REVISION) FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND X WHERE X.BUYER=O.BUYER AND X.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND X.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LATEST_YN ,CASE WHEN O.IF_FLAG='N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS WAIT_YN ,CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMPRDT P WHERE P.BUYER=O.BUYER AND P.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND P.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ AND P.STATUS!='D' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ORDER_EXISTS_YN ,CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMIVDT V WHERE V.BUYER=O.BUYER AND V.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND V.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ AND V.STATUS!='D' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELIVERY_EXISTS_YN ,CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMPOHD A ,ICOMPODT B ,ICOMPRDT P WHERE A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO=B.PO_NO AND A.STATUS!='D' AND A.AGENT IN('KRCRET0001','KRCRET0002') AND B.BUYER=P.BUYER AND B.PR_NO=P.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ=P.PR_SEQ AND B.STATUS!='D' AND P.STATUS!='D' AND B.ITEM_QTY>0 AND TRIM(B.SELLER_ITEM_NO) IS NOT NULL AND B.BUYER=O.BUYER AND B.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SELLER_ITEM_EXISTS_YN ,(SELECT MAX(X.REVISION)+1 FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND X WHERE X.BUYER=O.BUYER AND X.PR_NO=O.PR_NO AND X.PR_SEQ=O.PR_SEQ) AS NEXT_REVISION FROM EAI.IF_SUPPLY_PO_SEND O WHERE O.AGENT=#{st_agent} AND O.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND O.PO_NO=#{st_po_no} AND O.PO_SEQ=#{st_po_seq} AND O.STATUS='C' AND O.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND O.PR_NO=#{st_pr_no} AND O.PR_SEQ=#{st_pr_seq}
